what: A WebGL orb (80% of the box) with seven sunset colors (blue → gray → sand → orange) flowing around the sphere has two white pill-shaped eyes set in, turning its head to look toward the cursor — turn amount is .72·tanh(distance ÷ max(70, orb width × .87)), follows at 1 − e^(−14·dt) per frame, and blinks for 170ms every 3.8 to 6.2s (first blink at 3.2s). The flow runs at 3x real time (rotation .16 · waves .22 · .18 · .25), and on hover it scales 1.06x over .36s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). dock: with corner, the box pinned to the screen starts at the size and center of the hero slot (from), and while scrolling over the over section’s height × .72 it shrinks and moves with smoothstep into an 84px (64px on phone) slot at the bottom right corner

options.reach: Max eye turn (sine of a unit sphere), default .72
options.follow: Follow speed — 1 − e^(−follow·dt) per frame, default 14
options.dock: ”corner” pins to the screen and moves from the hero position to the bottom-right corner
options.from: Start position css of the dock (the short side of that box is the initial size)
options.over: CSS for the section that measures dock progress — a section wrapping the default from
options.travel: How many times the over height must be scrolled for it to fully settle, default .72
options.mobile: Width (px) counted as a phone, default 900 — only when from-mobile is present
options.from-mobile · max-mobile · size-mobile ·: Phone start-position CSS · initial size cap (default 170) · resting size (64) · margin (12)
options.max: Initial size cap on wide screens (px), default none
options.[data-fx-part=body] (child): (if present) the slot to draw the beads in — if the consumer applies an entrance motion (opacity·transform) to this slot, it won’t mix with the dock reposition. If absent, the part creates it
options.--fx-orb-1 … --fx-orb-7: (css variable) seven bead colors — default is a sunset rotated from --kf-accent

from.where: index.html .ab-mascot (floating mascot that moves from the Hero spot to settle at bottom right 84px) · subpages .ab-mascot--corner (sits in the corner, appears from 18px · .9x in .8s cubic-bezier(.9,0,.1,1)) — rebuilt from scratch with the same color, flow and eye values measured from the original mascot-shader.js

note: Without WebGL, only the eyes rotate on a circle with a same-color linear gradient. On touch devices the eyes look straight ahead. The original lays an eye-shaped graphic (svg) underneath and puts moving eyes on top, but this part draws only the moving eyes
